tool_args.rationale: The five paid rows cover only short horizons, while the task forecast horizon is 23.4 and the supplied dual-horizon mechanism predicts reversal around H=15–25. The designated slow-horizon probe directly tests the unresolved long-timescale behavior before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the sink-coupled dual-horizon reversal model from the five short-horizon rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observations have H ≤ 0.48, so they do not identify the slow adaptation term or establish the predicted long-horizon reversal near H=20.
More fine-grained data in the short-horizon regime would not resolve the key long-horizon ambiguity.
It is unrelated to distinguishing the candidate temporal mechanisms and has unnecessary cost.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a present-snapshot Lotka–Volterra or Ricker model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These alternatives do not account for the supplied history-conditioned horizon signature and short-positive/long-negative behavior.
